entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Ankur Chourasia, Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Rahul Solanki, Government Advocate for the non-app
 Order

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has been convicted in the alleged offence therefore, seeks leave of this Court to withdraw present bail application filed u/S 483 of BNSS in connection with Crime No.50/2015 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Nai Aabadi,
District Mandsaur (MP) for the offence u/S 363, 366, 376, 368, 328, 149, 365 and 120-B of IPC alongwith 3/4 of the POCSO Act, as the same has rendered infructuous.
The other side has no objection.
Accordingly, the present bail application is dismissed as having been rendered infructuous.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE gp Rahul vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116123671/
